reason: I run a sit-down place where most of my regulars are over 45, and they want a waiter and a paper menu. I am not going to pay R699 a month on a new company that has no restaurant live yet to show me.
objection: Half my regulars will not scan a QR code at the table, and I would still be ringing everything up on my POS, so I would be paying for a second screen in the kitchen on top of what I already have.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three restaurants like mine running it for a few months, with real numbers on table turnover and older guests actually ordering this way.
